tasks.title: Essay: Museum access priorities
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.text: In your English class you have been talking about how to make museums more inclusive. Now your English teacher has asked you to write an essay.

promptBlocks.heading: Notes
listItems: 2. guided tours for visitors with disabilities

promptBlocks.text: Write an essay using all the notes and giving reasons for your point of view.

tasks.title: Review: Museum inclusion programme
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.heading: Reviews wanted!
paragraphs: Have you visited a museum that has introduced an inclusion programme – for example, sensory-friendly hours, multilingual guides, or free entry for certain groups?
Write a review for a specialist magazine about museums.
Describe what the programme involved, say how effective it was for visitors, and recommend one improvement the museum could make.
The best reviews will be published in the next issue.

tasks.title: Article: Involving the community
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: Our town museum wants to attract more local residents. What could it do to become a more welcoming place for everyone?
Write an article for the museum's website suggesting one practical change the museum could make, explaining why it would work and what the benefits would be for the community.
We will publish the best articles on our website.

tasks.title: Email: Museum visit arrangements
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.subject: Museum visit next month
paragraphs: I'm planning to visit your town next month and I'd love to go to the local museum. I've heard it has a new inclusion programme. Can you tell me what the programme involves? Also, do you think it's worth visiting? And could you recommend one exhibit I shouldn't miss?
